algorithm: Seeded gaussian background plus a gaussian anomaly blob; threshold at mean + 2 sigma; BFS connected components to isolate and measure the blob.
complexity: O(N^2) for an N x N scan: generation, stats, thresholding, and BFS are each linear in pixels.
data_flow_ascii:
seed -> generate_scan (background + anomaly blob) -> grid
 grid -> region_stats -> mean, stdev, min, max
mean + 2*stdev -> threshold -> segment -> binary mask
mask -> connected_components (BFS) -> largest blob -> centroid, size
description_sentence: A synthetic scan analyzer that generates a seeded 2D scan with an anomalous blob, segments it by thresholding, and reports the blob centroid and size.
failure_note: If no pixel clears the threshold, the report says no anomaly was found instead of crashing on an empty mask.

label: imaging_analyzer
output_shape: Prints region statistics, the threshold, the detected blob centroid/size versus the true center, and an ASCII scan map.
pitch_sentence: I built a {topic} that synthesizes a scan, thresholds out the anomaly, and measures its centroid and size.

qa.a: Mean plus two standard deviations of the whole scan; the bright anomaly sits well above background noise.
Breadth-first search over 4-connected above-threshold pixels; the largest component is reported as the anomaly.
A brighter or larger blob segments cleanly; a faint one near the noise floor may split or vanish, which the report shows.
qa.q: What if the blob is faint?

resume_bullet_template: Built a {topic} in Python with synthetic scan generation, threshold segmentation, and connected-component blob measurement.
run_notes: --size sets the scan resolution; the true blob center is seeded and reported for accuracy comparison.
scaling_note: Pixel loops suit demo resolutions; megapixel scans would want numpy or tiled processing.
storage_note: No persistence: the scan is regenerated from the seed each run.
tech_stack: stdlib: argparse, random, math, statistics, collections
tradeoff_note: A global threshold is simple and fast but can miss faint anomalies that adaptive methods would catch.
